title: Q33 — What app did I order the takeout in my hand?

question.text: What app did I order the takeout in my hand?
question.annotator_reason: I opened Meituan Takeout on my phone

fine_caption_window.text: Lucia says, 'This is ordering coffee. I didn't know how to order at first. Then I ordered a pure espresso, just one shot. And I was really shocked when it came up. How do you drink this?' and laughs. I keep wiping the whiteboard, put down the eraser, turn right, and walk forward smiling. 'Yes,' I say. Shure says, 'Let's start lunch now.' I carry my…
fine_caption_window.note: The caption discusses ordering coffee and starting lunch but does not name the app — the answer is on the phone screen itself.

why_spatial_won: The episodic captions describe a flurry of micro-actions around lunch preparation; the spatial layer compresses these to a clean "I am in the kitchen near the dining table around lunch ordering time" anchor. With that anchor, the agent stops searching for a room and looks at the more specific lunch-ordering evidence, which clusters around Meituan in episodic.
pattern: An on-screen-object identification question where the 3-axis baseline drifted to Taobao but the 4-axis run picked Meituan. Demonstrates that placing a (hand, phone, kitchen) trio in the same prompt window helps the agent focus on the in-hand-phone-screen detail that episodic captions describe but never highlight.
